static_traits.name: Stephanie
static_traits.family_status: Lives with spouse and a black Labrador
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy; has not yet had similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, willing to cooperate; able to self-reflect; neutral attitude; occasional rationalization tendency

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling rejected and not good enough because my favorite musician Charlie Daniels hasn't replied to my fan letter, leading to worthlessness and self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of being rejected and not good enough are starting to affect my daily life and relationships with others.
growth_experiences: During a difficult hike last year, with slippery and very challenging terrain, the client felt unable to cope, and self-evaluation of hiking dropped markedly from then on, gradually forming the belief 'I am terrible at hiking', and frequently hesitating and avoiding hiking activities since.

Last month she sent a fan letter to her favorite musician Charlie Daniels but has not yet received a reply; this mattered greatly to the client, and the lack of response so far triggered intense feelings of being rejected and not being good enough, further developing into worthlessness and self-doubt, repeatedly triggered when hearing his music or seeing related posts.

core_beliefs: I don't deserve to be valued / recognized

special_situations.event: Favorite musician not replying to my fan letter yet
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my idol doesn't reply, it means I am not a good fan and don't deserve to be valued
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to interpret it as 'he is busy' to ease discomfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He must think I'm not a good fan

special_situations.event: When listening to Charlie Daniels' music or seeing posts related to him
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Without a response, it proves I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly telling myself 'he may be busy', trying to balance emotions but with limited effect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough,I have no value

special_situations.event: Thinks about or plans to go hiking, and associates it with that difficult hike last year
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One performance failure means I have always been bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids hiking trips, declines friends' hiking invitations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am terrible at hiking; I definitely can't keep up with others

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly, I'll disappoint my friends, proving I am useless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Declining invitations to avoid disappointing others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will drag everyone down; I disappoint them

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and recognized (as a fan and as a partner or companion)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected, being belittled, fearing disappointing others
defense_goal: Maintaining avoidance and self-repression to avoid being rejected again

object_relations.object_representation: Cold rejecter (idol / others won't respond or recognize)
object_relations.linking_affect: Sense of being rejected, shame, inferiority

object_relations.self_representation: Incapable hiker who drags others down
object_relations.object_representation: A harsh judger / friends who may be disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing 'the idol hasn't replied yet' and being invited to focus on the present hurt
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Unconsciously regards direct contact with painful experiences as possibly losing control or being judged, so turns to rational explanation to keep distance from emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a gentle, empathic tone, first naming and validating the hurt and sense of being rejected, inviting staying with the present experience within safe boundaries; avoiding overanalysis and direct advice, using more open-ended questions and concrete validation.

manifestations: Idol's lack of reply triggering intense experience of being rejected
Struggling to open up to my spouse about worthlessness
Reduced interaction with friends due to avoiding hiking invitations
outcomes: Avoiding activities and social contact, shrinking life experience

manifestations: Fear and self-doubt limiting choices to join hiking and other activities

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-denial ('I am not good enough')
Hard to express shame and rejection feelings to the spouse
Excessively worrying about disappointing others when friends invite me

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Avoiding directly facing the emotion of being rejected through the rational interpretation of 'he may be busy'
Avoiding directly facing ability anxiety through hesitation and procrastination when thinking about hiking

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interpreting the idol's lack of reply as 'he doesn't value me'
When invited by friends, presumes 'they will be disappointed'

exception_events.target_problem: When planning or being invited to hike, the client typically feels intense self-doubt and chooses avoidance, missing social and interest experiences.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In a few past hikes, the client felt strong, enjoyed the process, and felt proud at the end, unlike the current avoidance.
exception_events.reason: Clue: the route and pace at that time were more suitable, personal state was better, so it was easier to experience a sense of control and achievement.

positive_force: Has had successful hiking experiences and positive memories
Willing to try again and start from small, controllable goals
Able to identify negative thinking and actively seek counseling support
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as mental filtering, overgeneralization, mind reading, and personalization
High dependence on external responses (seeking external validation)
Sleep disturbance and decreased attention affecting function

antecedent: Thinking about hiking or planning a trip
Received a hiking invitation from a friend
Recalling last year's difficult hiking experience
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization and catastrophizing of one failure experience trigger strong doubt about their own ability
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential failure and shame, avoids disappointing others
target_behavior.consequence: Misses activities with friends and nature experiences, interests are damaged, life pleasure declines

target_behavior.behavior: Self-denial and rumination when encountering idol-related information
antecedent: Seeing online posts related to it
No reply received after sending the fan letter
target_behavior.core_reason: High dependence on external responses to confirm self-worth, and interprets events with mind reading and mental filtering
target_behavior.function: Seeking external validation and interpretation to try to reduce uncertainty (but actually maintaining pain)
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and worthlessness intensified, affecting work attention and sleep, fewer daily activities

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disturbance (difficulty falling asleep or easily waking at night)
antecedent: Repeatedly dwelling on thoughts of being rejected and not good enough before sleep
Worrying that work performance and relationships are affected
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent negative rumination leads to high arousal and difficulty relaxing
target_behavior.function: Unintentional physiological response; indirectly avoiding facing daytime discomfort emotions
target_behavior.consequence: Energy declines, concentration is impaired, and he further avoids previously enjoyed activities
